Here's the EXACT path from nothing to $10k/month:

First, understand what trading gurus doesn't want you to know:

You do not need money to learn how to trade. Zero. The education is free on YouTube. The practice is free on demo accounts. The charts are free on TradingView. Everything that costs money in traditional finance is completely free in 2026. The barrier isn't financial. It's informational. Most people simply don't know this path exists

Phase 1: Free education (week 1-4)

YouTube: "price action trading for beginners". Watch everything. Take physical notes, not mental notes. Writing forces your brain to process the information differently than passive watching

You're looking for ONE strategy. Here's what a good beginner strategy looks like:

- It has clear entry rules (specific conditions that must be true before you take the trade)
- It has a defined stop loss (the exact price where you exit if you're wrong)
- It has a defined take profit (the exact price where you collect your money)
- The take profit is at least 2-3x further than the stop loss (this means you make $3 for every $1 you risk)
- It appears at least 1-3 times per day (so you get enough repetitions to learn)

Some proven beginner concepts to research: fair value gap entries, order blocks, the 9:30am opening range, London session reversal.

Phase 2: Free practice (month 2-4)

Open a paper trading account on TradingView. It's completely free. They give you fake money to trade with. The charts, the execution, the fills. Everything works exactly like a real account. The only difference is no real money is involved

Trade your one strategy every single day during the 9:30-11:00am window (New York session) or the 2:00-5:00am window (London session). If you have a 9-5 job, trade London. Wake up early. Take your trades. Go back to sleep or go to work. Your boss never knows

Keep a trading journal. Every single trade. Here's what to write:

- Date and time of entry
- Why you entered (what setup did you see?)
- Where your stop loss was
- Where your take profit was
- What happened (win, loss, or breakeven)
- What you learned
- Screenshot of the chart

After 30 days, review your journal. You'll see patterns. You'll notice that you lose most money on Mondays (many traders do). You'll notice that your best trades happen between 9:30-10:30am. You'll notice that you keep making the same 2-3 mistakes

Fix those mistakes. Trade another 30 days. Review again. Fix again

You need 3 consecutive green months before moving to real money. Not 1. Not 2. Three. This is non-negotiable. If you can't make money with fake money, you will not make money with real money

"But that's so long"

It's 90 days. 90 days to potentially change your financial life permanently. You've wasted longer binge-watching Netflix shows you don't even remember

Phase 3: The $300 phase (month 5)

Buy a prop firm challenge. $300 gets you a $100,000 account test. Here's exactly what you need to do to pass:

- Hit an 8-10% profit target ($8,000-$10,000 in profit on the $100k account)
- Don't exceed 5% maximum drawdown ($5,000 maximum loss at any point)
- Don't exceed 2% daily drawdown ($2,000 maximum loss in a single day)
- Complete within 30 days

If your strategy gives you 1:3 risk to reward and you risk 1% per trade ($1,000), you need roughly 4-5 winning trades to pass. At 40-50% win rate with proper R:R, this is extremely achievable for someone who practiced for 3 months

The secret to passing: trade LESS, not more. Most people fail because they overtrade. They take 5 trades a day trying to hit the target fast. Each trade is a chance to lose. Take 1-2 high quality setups per day maximum. Let the math work over 30 days

Phase 4: Getting paid (month 6+)

You now control $100,000+ in capital that isn't yours. You keep 80% of the profits. Trade your strategy exactly like you practiced

Make 3% monthly → keep 80% → $2,400/month per account

Stack more accounts. Every new $100k account is another $2,400/month stream. Five accounts = $12,000/month. Ten accounts = $24,000/month

Here's what most people miss about scaling: you trade the SAME strategy on every account. Open all your trading platforms. When your setup appears, execute it on all accounts simultaneously. One morning of work. Multiple payouts

The system that keeps people broke is not a lack of opportunity. It's a lack of awareness that the opportunity exists

Every single person reading this has a phone, WiFi, and 90 free minutes per day

That's literally all you need

🚨 MARKET STRUCTURE TRADING CHEAT SHEET

✅ BOS = Break of Structure – trend confirmation

✅ BSL = Break of Structure Low – liquidity taken

✅ OB = Order Block – key reversal zone

✅ FVG = Fair Value Gap – price inefficiency

✅ IND = Inducement – liquidity trap before move

📌 KEY RULES TO REMEMBER;

✅ Price breaks structure & takes liquidity first

✅ Then returns to OB/FVG for confirmation

✅ Inducement traps late sellers/buyers

✅ Strong confirmation leads to continuation

🎯 TRADE WITH THE FLOW, NOT AGAINST IT

TS → CISD → IFVG → DOL

• TS: Liquidity grab sets the trap.
• CISD: Market shifts direction.
• IFVG: Entry zone appears.
• DOL: Confirms overall bias.

Flow: Grab → Shift → Entry →
